messages:
Zane (Sales): Heads-up — NewWave Therapeutics signed yesterday. Primary contacts: Priya (CTO) and Marco (Platform). They requested private VPC + Okta SCIM and want Dedicated capacity in ~4 weeks. Baseline ~2.5M tokens/mo, peaks ~5M. Procurement tends to be slow; flagging renewal-watch if PO not in by 30 days. Passing to CS + Eng + Support for kickoff and runbook.

Camila (CS): Ill take the CS lead. Ill set a 30m technical kickoff with Priya/Marco. Can Sales drop sample prompts and a short list of priority flows (chat, batch, webhooks)? Also need billing contact and any compliance constraints (they mentioned pharma-regulated data).

Zane (Sales): Sample prompts are in the Drive: https://drive.redwood/newwave-examples. Priority flows: 1) low-latency clinical chat (p95 target 300ms) 2) nightly batch embeddings 3) webhook classification. Billing contact is Leah (RevOps) ccd. PO ETA currently ~3 weeks but could slip.

Owen (Eng): Ill own VPC/peering + SSO precheck. ETA: 3 business days for initial checklist + risk notes. Need test CIDR, allowed egress ports, and their infra contact (Marco). Also confirm expected model: which quantized checkpoint and max seq len? Recommend a canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

Pri (Support): Ill draft the support runbook and playbook. Initial checklist Im starting with:
```
preflight:
  - validate peering & route tables
  - SCIM provisioning test
monitoring:
  - p95 latency <350ms
  - 5xx rate <0.5%
escalation:
  - cs-oncall -> eng-oncall -> infra-owner
```
Will publish v1 in the shared kickoff doc by end of week.

Leah (RevOps): Ill push the PO lane. Procurement asked for SOC2 and DPA; Ill surface any contract exceptions. Ill set renewal-watch if PO >30 days and loop AM.

handoff-bot: Kickoff event created: Mon 09:00am PT "NewWave onboarding intake" (invitees: Zane, Camila, Owen, Pri, Priya).

Camila (CS): Proposed owners & deadlines in kickoff doc: Camila (CS lead) — collect requirements & run kickoff (by Mon), Owen (Eng) — precheck & GPU sizing (3bd), Pri (Support) — runbook draft (4bd), Leah (RevOps) — PO follow-up (ongoing). Risks: procurement timeline, SOC2/DPA, and potential SLA add-on if they want 24/7.

Zane (Sales): Model notes added: redwood/opt-13b-quant, checkpoint ~11GB post-quant, typical seq len 512 (chat), batch up to 2048. Concurrency peak ~30 rps.

Owen (Eng): Noted. Ill include GPU hour estimates and memory footprint for procurement. If dedicated GPUs not ready day 1, fallback policy will use hosted compat model.

Pri (Support): Quick ask — do we want a joint runbook drill with their oncall in week 2? I recommend yes (simulate latency spike + failover).

Camila (CS): Yes, schedule drill week 2. Also well capture 30d feedback (small NPS + qualitative notes). Who owns feedback capture?

Leah (RevOps): I can own the billing & renewal watch and collect procurement SLAs. Ill also record the renewal-risk tag if PO slips beyond 30 days.

Camila (CS): Summary Ill paste into the doc and into the kickoff invite: owners, deliverables, deadlines, risks, and the plan for a week-2 runbook drill. Ill update this thread after kickoff with the finalized runbook link. Closing loop for now.
